reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text: There are plenty of moons calendar apps. I got this one to use the widget to keep up with the lunar calendar easier but you have to pay and by pro for that. I’m tired of apps that hide everything behind a paywall rather than offering special and unique features to encourage users to want to upgrade or spend money on their apps.

reviews.title: Malicious adds
reviews.text: I love the app, but the last time I opened it, the whole screen had an advertisement banner which was a screenshot of a home screen with a with a “your phone is hacked” warning.  So they need to ditch their add network, as it’s being used to serve scams through their app.

reviews.title: Tracks you
reviews.text: I have my location off and this app set to never sharing location and they still were showing my location on their map.  The app itself is pretty cool but their sneaky behavior is not!
